solutions.title: Recursive pair rewiring
solutions.strategy: Swap the first two original nodes, recursively solve the rest of the list, and attach the pair tail to that result.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each recursive call consumes one adjacent pair, so every node is visited and rewired at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack holds one frame per swapped pair in the worst case.

solutions.title: Iterative pair rewiring
solutions.strategy: Use a dummy node and rewire each adjacent pair in place while preserving the next segment.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node participates in at most one pair swap and is visited once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a dummy node and a few pointers are stored while the original nodes are reused.
